title: Bundle Mop config
description: Per-route JS size budgets for Bundle Mop. The first entry whose route pattern matches a route applies.

route.description: Route pattern: exact ("/"), "*" matches one segment, "**" any number of segments. Wildcards never match Next-internal routes such as /_not-found.

firstLoad.description: Max first-load JS (minified bytes) for matching routes.

lazy.description: Max lazily loaded (next/dynamic) JS for matching routes.

client.description: Max total client JS (first-load + lazy) for matching routes.

size.description: A size like "150 kB" (1 kB = 1000 B), "146.5 KiB", "1.5 MB", or a number of bytes.
